BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_version (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    tech_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (tech_id, version)
);

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tech_version_id uuid NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_version_tech_version') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_version
        ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_version_tech_version
        FOREIGN KEY (tech_version_id) REFERENCES tech_version(id);
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'version'
    ) THEN
        -- Backfill tech_version and course_version.tech_version_id using course main tech.
        WITH source AS (
            SELECT
                cv.id AS course_version_id,
                COALESCE(c.main_tech_id, ct.tech_id) AS tech_id,
                cv.version::text AS version
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN course c ON c.id = cv.course_id
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT tech_id
                FROM course_tech
                WHERE course_id = c.id
                ORDER BY tech_id
                LIMIT 1
            ) ct ON TRUE
            WHERE cv.tech_version_id IS NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO tech_version (id, tech_id, version, created_at)
        SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), source.tech_id, source.version, now()
        FROM source
        WHERE source.tech_id IS NOT NULL AND source.version IS NOT NULL
        ON CONFLICT (tech_id, version) DO NOTHING;

        WITH mapping AS (
            SELECT
                cv.id AS course_version_id,
                tv.id AS tech_version_id
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN course c ON c.id = cv.course_id
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT tech_id
                FROM course_tech
                WHERE course_id = c.id
                ORDER BY tech_id
                LIMIT 1
            ) ct ON TRUE
            JOIN tech_version tv
                ON tv.tech_id = COALESCE(c.main_tech_id, ct.tech_id)
                AND tv.version = cv.version::text
            WHERE cv.tech_version_id IS NULL
        )
        UPDATE course_version cv
        SET tech_version_id = mapping.tech_version_id
        FROM mapping
        WHERE cv.id = mapping.course_version_id;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE course_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_course_id_version_key;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS version;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_tech_version_id ON course_version(tech_version_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_version_tech_id ON tech_version(tech_id);

COMMIT;
